items.title: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Template Engine Injection (BlockStrap)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0 allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released a fix as part of APSB26-153, but it requires a manual patch.

items.title: Unauthenticated Code Execution in Adobe Commerce B2B due to Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.8), addressed in APSB26-153, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to an incorrect authorization flaw.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including five classified as Critical, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of active exploitation in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) as this vulnerability was actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security Update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (e.g., CVE-2026-76200).

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability allowing Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1, allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges over sensitive store data and configuration without user interaction.
